provenance.writtenFor: DAST defensive-batch evaluation (2026-10-21): ordinary hardened response controls
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A fully hardened HTML response must not trigger any of the 17 defensive checks added in this batch.

groundTruth.rationale: Every security header is present with a strict value, the only cookie is a __Host- cookie with Path=/ and a one-hour Max-Age, and the markup contains no inline javascript: link, no plaintext base, no meta refresh and no dev-server script. A detector that fires here is reporting ordinary hardened behaviour as a weakness.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live target.
All 17 rules from the defensive batch are named, not a hand-picked subset; no rule was removed after the first run.
